title: Torrential rains trigger maximum alerts and flooding in Nagoya and central Japan
summary: Record precipitation activates level 5 alerts and evacuation orders in Aichi and Gifu, with river overflows and transport disruptions.

title: 'Chuto' party dissolves and its members seek to form new parliamentary groups
summary: The centrist formation decides on formal dissolution as opposition lawmakers explore creating a new party and a unified faction in the Lower House.

title: Yen surges sharply and Tokyo stock market falls on macroeconomic fears
summary: Japanese currency tops 152 per dollar and Nikkei loses over 1,000 points on concerns about US economy and end of negative rates.

title: Government and parties agree to bring forward compensatory payment for VAT hike to 2029
summary: The 'income-linked benefit' scheme will be implemented in spring 2029 to mitigate the impact of the reversal of the temporary consumption tax cut.

title: Lawyer Atsumi Harasawa gains business sector backing for Yokohama mayoralty
summary: Local business leaders urge the attorney to run in municipal elections, seeking a change of administration after the current term.

title: Arson at a Gifu pastry shop leaves three dead; gasoline can found
summary: Police investigate possible murder-arson after finding a fuel container in the ruins of the establishment where three people died.

title: At 88, navigator Kenichi Horie embarks on a new solo Pacific crossing
summary: The veteran adventurer sets sail from Japan bound for San Francisco in a non-stop attempt, defying his age and ocean conditions.

title: Japan retains fourth place in reading in PISA 2022 despite global decline in skills
summary: OECD report reveals widespread decline in reading and math performance, attributed partly to social media use and the pandemic.

title: Foreign Minister Motegi demands Iran contain attacks on merchant vessels in the Middle East
summary: In a phone call, Japan urges Tehran to exercise restraint to avoid an escalation affecting maritime security and energy supply.

title: 'Mumeijuku' theater school, founded by Tatsuya Nakadai, closes after 50 years of history
summary: The prestigious academy that trained actors such as Koji Yakusho announces its dissolution for February 2027, ten months after the death of its founder.

title: Three people arrested for murder of Nepalese woman in Fukuoka
summary: The victim was found in a river in critical condition; the detainees, her compatriots, allegedly acted over romantic troubles.

title: Celebrity Devi Sukarno faces 200,000 yen fine for assault with champagne glass
summary: Prosecutors seek monetary penalty for incident at a restaurant; defense cites mitigating circumstances.

title: Real wages in Japan grow 2.4% in July, seventh consecutive monthly increase
summary: The rise outpaces inflation for the first time in nearly five years, driven by wage hikes and price moderation.

title: Great Gidayu, historic member of 'Takeshi Gundan,' dies at 67
summary: The comedian, whose real name was Yoshihiro Tsumura, had been battling diabetes for years.
